fr_html: LORD PHILLIMORE pense d'accord avec Mr. Root, que la question des incompatibilités concernant les suppléants est peu importante. Il trouve cependant préférable d'assimiler les juges suppléants aux juges titulaires.
en_html: LORD PHILLIMORE thought, as also did Mr. Root, that the question of incompatible functions was unimportant, with regard to the deputy judges. He thought, however, that it would be preferable to class the deputy and regular judges together.
